meta.title: Heritage Experiences — Whizzzest
meta.description: Hands-on Wanzai heritage experiences — fireworks making, Nuo mask painting, Xiabu weaving and Desheng Drum workshops — are being prepared. Stay tuned.

hero.title: Heritage experiences
hero.subtitle: Touch Wanzai's living heritage with your own hands (in preparation — stay tuned)

plansDesc: We are preparing hands-on workshops with local heritage bearers. A first look at what's coming:

plans.name: Fireworks making workshop
plans.desc: Step into a fireworks workshop and, under a bearer's guidance, learn the traditional steps — rolling tubes, packing powder, inserting fuses — and witness the birth of a firework.

plans.name: Kaikou Nuo mask painting
plans.desc: Pick a blank Nuo mask, paint it with a master, and take home the ancient patterns that ward off evil and invite blessing.

plans.name: Xiabu weaving demonstration
plans.desc: Sit at an old loom, feel the sizing and the shuttle, and watch ramie become gossamer grass cloth, thread by thread.

plans.name: Desheng Drum session
plans.desc: Learn a passage of Desheng Drum beats with the troupe and feel the bold spirit of Wanzai in the thunderous rhythm.

cta.title: Explore Wanzai meanwhile
cta.desc: While the workshops are in preparation, follow our tour routes to the birthplaces of these traditions and taste Wanzai at its source.
